seoTitle: Which Prison Break Character Are You? Prison Break Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Prison Break test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Michael, Lincoln, Sara, T-Bag, Mahone, Sucre or Bellick — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the calm planner with a secret escape route, the one who'd charge through a wall for family, or the one nobody should ever fully trust? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle trouble, loyalty and feeling trapped, and find out which Prison Break character you are.

characters.name: Michael Scofield
characters.title: The Calm Mastermind
characters.summary: Brilliant, calm and always ten steps ahead. You plan everything — and you'd do anything for the people you love.
description: Like Michael, you think in plans. He's a structural engineer who had the blueprints of a prison tattooed on his body so he could break his brother out.
You stay calm when everyone around you is panicking. You've already thought about what could go wrong — and what to do about it.
You feel things deeply, but you keep them locked away. The people you love are the whole reason you do any of it.
characters.flaw: You carry everything alone and take on far too much responsibility.
characters.signature: A full-body tattoo, an origami crane and a plan B, C and D.
characters.clashReason: they'd have a plan they won't tell you about

characters.name: Lincoln Burrows
characters.title: The Protective Fighter
characters.summary: Tough, protective and driven by family. You'd rather charge through a wall than plan your way around it.
description: Like Lincoln, you're a fighter. He was on death row for a murder he didn't commit, and he never stopped fighting to clear his name.
You're protective to the core. When Lincoln's family is in danger, nothing on earth will stop him.
You're not the planner — you're the muscle, the heart and the one who never gives up.
characters.flaw: You act before you think, and your temper gets you into trouble.
characters.signature: A shaved head, a clenched jaw and a brother he'd die for.
characters.clashReason: they'd charge in before you've thought it through

characters.name: Sara Tancredi
characters.title: The Principled Healer
characters.summary: Compassionate, strong-willed and principled. You help people — even when it costs you everything.
description: Like Sara, you want to help. She was the prison doctor at Fox River, and she treated every inmate like a person.
You've fought your own battles. Sara was recovering from addiction, and she rebuilt her life through sheer determination.
You're tougher than anyone expects. When life gets dangerous, you don't just survive — you fight back.
characters.flaw: You trust your heart even when your head is warning you.
characters.signature: A doctor's coat, a steady hand and the origami rose Michael made her.
characters.clashReason: they'd see the good in people you don't trust

characters.name: T-Bag
characters.title: The Silver-Tongued Menace
characters.summary: Charming, cunning and completely untrustworthy. You always find a way to survive — and nobody ever knows whose side you're on.
description: Let's be honest: you got the villain. Like T-Bag, you're a survivor — smooth-talking, unpredictable and always working an angle.
You can talk your way into or out of almost anything, and your vocabulary is surprisingly fancy for a man in a prison jumpsuit.
Relax — in real life this just means you're resourceful, quick-witted and very hard to get rid of. Hopefully.
characters.flaw: You'll betray anyone to save yourself.
characters.signature: A menacing smile and a very fancy word used in a very threatening way.
characters.clashReason: they'd betray you the first chance they got

characters.name: Alexander Mahone
characters.title: The Haunted Genius
characters.summary: Brilliant, intense and haunted by your past. You're one of the few people who can think like a mastermind — because you are one.
description: Like Mahone, you're frighteningly smart. He's the FBI agent who hunted the escaped Fox River inmates, and he was the only one who could keep up with Michael's mind.
You're intense and driven, but you carry heavy things from your past that you don't talk about.
Over time, you surprise people. Mahone went from hunter to unlikely ally.
characters.flaw: Your past haunts you, and you'll cross lines to protect your secrets.
characters.signature: A sharp suit, a bottle of pills he won't talk about and a stare that says he's already figured you out.
characters.clashReason: they'd never stop hunting you down

characters.name: Fernando Sucre
characters.title: The Loyal Romantic
characters.summary: Loyal, warm and a total romantic. You got into all this for love — and you'd never betray a friend.
description: Like Sucre, you're loyal to your core. He's Michael's cellmate, and once he's on your side, he's on your side for good.
You're a romantic. Everything Sucre does is for Maricruz, the woman he loves.
You're funny, warm and the one who keeps everyone human in the darkest moments.
characters.flaw: You follow your heart even when it leads straight into danger.
characters.signature: A photo of his girlfriend and an unbreakable promise.
characters.clashReason: they'd put love before everything, including the plan

characters.name: Brad Bellick
characters.title: The Bully With a Twist
characters.summary: Loud, stubborn and a bit of a bully at first. But life humbles you, and you end up surprising everyone.
description: Like Bellick, you like being in charge. He was the head guard at Fox River, and he enjoyed the power more than he should have.
You're stubborn and a little petty, and you hold a grudge for a long time.
But you change. Bellick ended up on the other side of the bars — and by the end, he surprised even the people who hated him.
characters.flaw: You're petty, and power goes to your head.
characters.signature: A guard's uniform, a set of keys and a grudge.

questions.text: You've just moved somewhere new. The first thing you do is...

options.text: Figure out how the whole place is put together
Work out who really runs the place and get on their good side
Call the person you love and describe every detail
Make it very clear to the neighbours this is your space

questions.text: You fall for someone you really shouldn't — they're taken, or it's someone you work with. You...

options.text: Go for it without thinking it through
Tell them. Love is worth the risk
Try to keep it professional — and fail
Flirt anyway. Rules are for other people

questions.text: Someone is wrong about something important and won't listen. You...

options.text: Prove it to them, piece by piece, until they can't argue
Stop arguing and just do it yourself
Stay patient and keep explaining. They'll come round
Remind them who's in charge here

questions.text: You made a promise you now can't keep. You...

options.text: Find a way. There's always a way
Tell them the truth and apologise
Promise? What promise?
Keep it anyway, even if it costs you everything
Build something complicated — a model, a puzzle, anything
Work on a car. Or anything with an engine
Spend every minute of it with the person you love
Take a long, quiet walk to clear your head

questions.text: You find a wallet stuffed with cash on the street. You...

options.text: Hand it straight in. It's not yours
Return it — and charm a reward out of the owner
Pocket the cash. Nobody will ever know
Track the owner down yourself from what's inside

questions.text: Your family needs something big from you. You...

options.text: Drop everything. No questions asked
Quietly work out a plan they don't even know about
Help — but tell them honestly how you feel about it
Say yes — and make sure they never see what it costs you
Order the fanciest thing and use every big word on the menu
Find the cheapest place and still complain about the bill
Pick somewhere healthy. Someone has to
Order exactly what you'd decided on before you walked in

questions.text: Someone who treated you badly now needs your help. You...

options.text: Help. Everyone deserves a second chance
Smile, help — and remember they owe you
Give them a chance. You've done things you're not proud of either
Refuse. Then turn up and help anyway

questions.text: You're blamed for something you didn't do. You...

options.text: Get angry. Very angry
Quietly gather the proof that clears your name
Stay calm and tell the truth. It'll come out
Make sure someone else takes the fall instead

questions.text: You're in prison and you've planned an escape for months. The night before, a cellmate you don't trust finds out and demands to come — or he'll tell the guards. You...

options.text: Rework the plan to fit him in. You'll deal with him later
Work out what he really wants, and use it against him
Bring him. You're not leaving anyone behind
Call it off. Someone's going to get hurt

questions.text: You've broken out of prison with a group. There's only enough money to get half of you across the border. You...

options.text: Give your share to someone with a family waiting
Take the money and go. Every man for himself
Split off with the one person you'd die for
Keep the money — and remember there's a reward on their heads
